notes.title: RECENT UPDATES:
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28134694/46c9bbb6429ac21302a1e87aa0e958565c60f086.png

Hello fellow "Heroes of the Arrow",

We are excited at how much fun people are having with Twisted Arrow, and we love the great feedback you've given us. We're here to make sure that you continue to have fun and the game gets better. Your comments and feedback are constantly helping us improve and add new features to the game. This is our first real patch taking your suggestions into account:

1. Improved frame rate - found a few places we were able to optimize
2. Bow angle adjustment range increased - you now have more options for your bow angle
3. Added an option to rest the arrow on the other side of the bow
4. Added an option for "non-dash" style teleporting
5. Fixed a bug that caused some invisible objects in the world
6. Reduced the extra-long pause at the end of the Prison Mission
7. Mixed reality recording is working. We're still finding a few issues in certain situations, but we will address those and keep working on it
8. Other miscellaneous bug fixes.

What's next?
ARCADE MODE!

More info to come...
